_comment: Snow driven sideways (design 5.2) -- inferno's inverse, and written as its mirror on purpose.
Temperature and rainfall are DEMANDS rather than limits, exactly as inferno.json's are, and for the
same reason: a limit yields silently to anything outside it, so `scorching blizzard` would have been
free. A demand fractures against one it cannot meet, which is the charge -- and writing a blizzard into
a hot Age should cost, because that is a writer asking for two things that cannot both be true
(Jonah, 2026-09-05). Compatible words still merge: `frozen blizzard` is not a quarrel.
It is the mirror of inferno's demand and not a wider one. Inferno takes 0.5..1.0 of the temperature
axis and this takes -1.0..-0.5, so the two overlap nowhere and the opposition is exact.
The snow is the warning sign and no other word may offer it, on the rule embers already live by: a
signal that also appears where nothing is wrong stops being one.
How often it blows and how long it stays is NOT here. That is the phenomenon's own axis -- a rung on
this word says how hard it was asked for, and Blizzard.shareOfTheTime turns that into weather.
Nothing about the snow itself gets fiercer, which is the register 5.2 asks for.
